title: South Savo: what EUR 1,000,000 a year should buy first in lung cancer care
markdown:
# South Savo: what EUR 1,000,000 a year should buy first in lung cancer care

## The gap in one sentence
In 2025, 69.7% of non-urgent GP visits in South Savo waited over 7 days, against 54.7% nationally [^sotkanet_6411]. This is measured, and the county ranks 4th worst of 22 [^sotkanet_6411]. In 2019–2023, 23.4% of the county's lung cancer patients got curative-intent treatment, against 27.0% nationally [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. Applying the top-quartile county rate to the county's patients gives about 6.2 more patients a year with curative-intent treatment; this is arithmetic on registry shares, not a causal estimate [^fcr_lung_quality_report]. The model estimates 149 days (135–166) from first symptom to treatment start [^model].

## Where the days are lost
The step furthest above the national value is first primary care contact to referral, estimated at 47 days (38–58) against 41 nationally [^model]. Two measured drivers sit behind that estimate:
- the GP wait share above [^sotkanet_6411]
- low continuity of care, with a COCI of 0.17 against 0.29 nationally [^sotkanet_5502]

Diagnosis to treatment start is measured, not modelled [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28]. It is 29.6 days against 36.9 nationally, but the figure is published for the Eastern Finland (KYS) collaborative area and weighted by the county's treatment mix, not measured for the county itself [^src_fi_assets_files_2024_12_Keuhkosyopa_Suomessa_pdf_p28].

## Three actions
None of these three shortens the pathway [^model]. Same-day chest X-ray reporting with immediate CT ranks fourth, at an estimated 24 days saved [^model].

1. **What:** Symptom awareness campaign telling people with a cough lasting over three weeks to see a doctor. **Owner:** FICAN and the Cancer Society, with local delivery by county communications and primary care. **Cost:** EUR 10,518 a year, sourced from the roadmap budget per resident; repeating it every year is an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; 0.37 (0.16–0.56) deaths avoided a year, estimated [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_symptom_campaign_1] [^ev_symptom_campaign_2] [^ev_symptom_campaign_3] **Roadmap:** 1.3.2, national communication plan on cancer symptoms [^roadmap_1.3.2].

2. **What:** Low-dose CT screening, with smoking cessation support, for long-term heavy smokers aged 50–74. It needs a national decision first, and benefits arrive after years. **Owner:** Ministry of Social Affairs and Health and Palko (decision), Finnish Cancer Registry (steering), county (delivery). **Cost:** EUR 404,432 a year, an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; 2.88 (2.11–3.65) deaths avoided a year, estimated [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_ldct_screening_1] [^ev_ldct_screening_2] [^ev_ldct_screening_3] [^ev_ldct_screening_4] **Roadmap:** 2.3.4, new national screening programmes [^roadmap_2.3.4].

3. **What:** Cessation medication and counselling for every current smoker at the first pulmonology visit. **Owner:** Chief physician and head nurse of pulmonology. **Cost:** EUR 36,840 a year, an assumption [^model]. **Expected effect:** 0 days saved; 0.29 (0.2–0.38) deaths avoided a year, estimated [^model]. **Evidence:** [^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_1] [^ev_smoking_cessation_at_diagnosis_2] **Roadmap:** 3.1.2, cancer-specific care pathway descriptions [^roadmap_3.1.2].

## What to measure from Monday
- Date of first symptom and of first primary care contact for every suspected lung cancer.
- Date of referral and date of first pulmonology visit.
- Date of first specialist visit and date of diagnosis, by hospital.
- Stage at diagnosis and treatment intent, by county.

## Limits of this analysis
The step days are county-level estimates built on assumed, not fitted, priors [^model]. They are not measurements of individual pathways [^model]. As a check, not a validation, none of three measured outcomes correlated with the estimated clock in the expected direction beyond chance; curative-intent share came closest (rho −0.30, p 0.17) [^model]. The national total is held at 155 days, reported by Yle in 2026 from an unpublished four-city Finnish study [^src_yle_fi_a_74_20250979].
